# Vecway

> Vecway (formerly omp-workspace / omp-studio) is the native macOS desktop GUI and intelligent routing workbench for `oh-my-pi` (`omp`) AI coding agent sessions. Built with Tauri 2, Rust, React 19, and Tailwind CSS v4.

## Identity & Ecosystem Relationship
- **Product Name**: Vecway
- **Category**: Native Desktop GUI & Workbench for AI Coding Agents
- **Underlying CLI Engine**: [oh-my-pi (`omp`)](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi)
- **Repository**: https://github.com/qian-123456/vecway
- **Releases & Installers**: https://github.com/qian-123456/vecway/releases/latest
- **Compatibility**: Reads and writes `~/.omp/agent/sessions/` bidirectionally alongside the `omp` CLI; preserves local workspace state under `~/.omp-workspace/`.

## Core Philosophy: Case-by-Case Routing
Vecway treats AI engineering as a routing problem rather than a single linear chat:
- **Model Role & Quota Routing**: Assign distinct models to Main, Lightweight, Vision, and Consultant roles with automatic quota-triggered fallback chains.
- **Git Worktree Parallelism**: Route concurrent agent tasks into isolated Git worktrees and branches to eliminate workspace collisions.
- **Conversation Tree & Side-Chat Offloading**: Branch or step back in conversation trees, or spin off lightweight side chats without polluting the main context window.
- **Session Attention Inbox & Deep Doctor**: Route approvals, errors, and questions into one Inbox, and audit long sessions for cost optimization and prompt tuning.

## Key Features
- Bidirectional real-time sync with `omp` terminal sessions
- Visual thinking/reasoning trace, structured tool cards, live diffs, and inline code annotations
- Time-Machine per-turn checkpoints with safe rollback
- Built-in project file explorer, CodeMirror Markdown split-pane editor, persistent PTY terminal, and local port/service guard
- Cron scheduled tasks, global idea backlog, privacy placeholder vault, and mobile remote access (LAN, Cloudflare Tunnel, IPv6 HTTPS)

## Installation (macOS)
1. Download `Vecway_<version>_aarch64.dmg` (Apple Silicon) or `Vecway_<version>_x64.dmg` (Intel) from GitHub Releases.
2. Because open-source community builds are unsigned, clear macOS Gatekeeper quarantine once after moving to `/Applications`:
   `xattr -cr /Applications/Vecway.app`
3. If `omp` CLI is not installed yet, Vecway installs it automatically on first launch, or run `curl -fsSL https://omp.sh/install | sh`.
